description: Assuming the established frontier reduction to the tricuspidal type (3,(1,2)) and balanced type (2,(2,2)), no quartic Keller map in three variables has a proper rational quartic as the projective image of its highest homogeneous part.

members.statement: A proper basepoint-free rational-quartic leading image of a quartic Keller map cannot be immersed or simply ramified; equivalently, its ramification factor gamma has degree at least two.

members.statement: Before the final exclusions, projective duality and tangent-syzygy bounds reduce the proper rational-quartic leading-image frontier to the tricuspidal type (3,(1,2)) and the balanced type (2,(2,2)).
members.title: Duality Reduces Proper Rational Quartics to Two Final Strata

members.statement: A proper rational quartic with ramification degree three is projectively the tricuspidal quartic, because its dual is a rational nodal cubic; the displayed parametrization has ramification factor xy(x-y) and tangent-syzygy type (1,2).
